title: git blame on a bug
caption:
ran git blame to find who broke checkout.

line 3, last week: return item.price * tax. so every total was just the tax.
line 5, yesterday: "// who wrote this??"
line 6, five minutes ago: "// oh." every line: me.

have you ever git blamed yourself?

slide.kicker: the culprit was always in the mirror
